title: Adaptive Randomized Block Scan with Monotonic Threshold Filtering

claims.assertion: DeepSelect decouples TopK compaction complexity from vocabulary length N by processing contiguous blocks B in uniform random permutation order, maintaining a monotonic non-decreasing threshold T initialized to -inf. Expected elements processed by in-loop Radix compactions is bounded by E[W] <= (1 + k/B2) * (k + B + B2) * H_m = O(k log(N/k)) when B, B2 = Theta(k).
